hint.level_1: Identify which operation to use. First count one layer: 5 × 2 = 10. Then multiply by height: 10 × 3. It's just multiplication.

questions.original_stem: How many lines of symmetry does a rectangle (non-square) have?

hint.level_0: A line of symmetry folds the shape onto itself.
hint.level_1: Imagine folding a rectangle (non-square) in different ways. Each fold that matches counts. Try vertical, horizontal, and diagonal folds. Be careful with regular shapes.
hint.level_2: A rectangle (non-square) has 2 lines of symmetry.

questions.visual_context: A rectangle with length and width labelled.
solution_steps: Imagine folding the shape along a line
Both halves must match exactly when folded
Count how many such fold lines exist
